answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent burns 50 credits to claim one marble slot; one per key. A prism roster lists slots, holders, exposing double claims. Each slot's pigment seal fades after one idle epoch, forcing a fresh burn. Prices rise as slots fill: k-th slot 50+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes burn 3,047,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented slots fail: one seal cannot cover many keys. Honest agents burn 50 once and keep working.
